lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: There it is. The Promised Land. No dancing. No yelling. Just... paper.

lines.speaker: Enzo
lines.text: We aren't giving away free candy, if that's what you're asking.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I... uh... I want to join? For the clearance?

lines.speaker: Enzo
lines.text: Oh. A writer? Or an artist?

lines.speaker: Enzo
lines.text: Good enough. We need encoders. Just write your name legibly. Don't be late. And don't use Comic Sans on the form.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Comic Sans? Whatever. I just need the signature.
